name: asodeltol-academic-catalog
description: Herramientas para validar el catálogo AF8 y ejecutar QA local reproducible.

scripts.test: node --test tests/catalog/*.test.mjs tests/academic/*.test.mjs tests/localization/*.test.mjs tests/deployment-*.test.mjs tests/agents/*.test.mjs
scripts.qa:anexo14:all: npm run qa:anexo14:manifest && npm run qa:close19:population && npm run qa:close19:identity && npm run qa:close19:links && npm run qa:close19:workflows
scripts.qa:close19:population: docker cp scripts/staging/close19/bulk350.php asodeltol-close19-webserver-1:/tmp/bulk350.php && docker exec --user www-data asodeltol-close19-webserver-1 php /tmp/bulk350.php && docker cp asodeltol-close19-webserver-1:/tmp/close19-bulk350.json build/staging/close19/bulk350/fixture.json
scripts.qa:close19:identity: docker cp scripts/staging/close19/identity_fixture.php asodeltol-close19-webserver-1:/tmp/identity_fixture.php && docker exec --user www-data asodeltol-close19-webserver-1 php /tmp/identity_fixture.php && docker cp asodeltol-close19-webserver-1:/tmp/close19-identity.json build/staging/close19/identity/result.json
